name: Standard 3DGS Training Configuration
definition: densify_until_iter controls the adaptive density-control block, including the accumulation of densification statistics, Gaussian densification and pruning, and periodic opacity reset.
summary: Standard 3DGS Training Configuration specifies the canonical hyperparameters for optimizing 3D Gaussian Splatting, distinguished by its strict adherence to the official implementation's default parameters for densification and opacity management.
